_about: Which density tier of an image the original draws, and at what size (sim/Tiers). The
original keeps an hd/ and a fullhd/ folder beside some image folders and, per file,
draws the tier file when it exists, at texels / density units. The port fixes the
choice the original makes at a 720 px screen. Step 61 of

_source: by ETHAppEnmlFile::LoadProperties (ETHAppEnmlFile.cpp:126-136) and handed over by
engine's own defaults are NOT the game's: fullHdDensityValue 4 and thresholds 720/1080
the screen is at least 600 px tall and FileExists; else <dir>/hd/<file> when it is at
least 480 px tall (or passed the fullhd test) and FileExists; else the ld/ and xld/
SetSpriteDensityValue sizes the bitmap texels / density (GLES2Sprite.cpp:429-438).
_ruling: R12, the owner's standing ruling (in favour of what the original does, as measured):
the choice is the one the original makes at a 720 px screen, for every window the port
opens. At 720 fullhd is tried first (720 >= 600) and hd second: ShouldUseHdResources is
false there (it excludes fullhd heights, :61-64), but the hd branch also runs whenever
the fullhd test passed (:105). Every library frame of the original and every fit against
it is 1280 x 720, so 720 is the only measured choice; the original's re-derivation per
R13, route B: the port resolves the tier from the file name; the converter's levels
name the 1x file and stay byte-identical.
_not_ported: The ld/ (density 0.5) and xld/ (0.25) tiers, tried only when the screen is at most 480
or 320 px tall (maxScreenHeightBeforeNdVersion and maxScreenHeightBeforeLdVersion, left
at the engine's defaults by app.enml). Not tried at 720, and the APK ships no ld/ or xld/
_census: The APK's tier folders (reference/extracted/assets): entities/hd 53 files, 52 exactly 2x
their 1x file and ghost.png 973 x 256 over 486 x 128; entities/fullhd 7, of which
arch_with_base_blur, satellite_sky and spiral are 2x and sky, icy_sky, red_sky and
sky_purple are 1024 x 512 over 455 x 256 (so 512 x 256 units: the fullhd sky is wider,
not only sharper); particles/hd 4, crystal_particle and question_mark 2x and
exclamation_mark_.png and tesla_shock_.png with no 1x name, so never chosen; sprites/hd
69; ETHFramework/sprites/hd 1. No image folder has both an hd and a fullhd file of one
